programme.desc: Zwei Ingenieure sind mit ihrem Roboter Blasius auf dem Weg zur Leipziger Messe. Im Zug gerät der junge Frantik aus Prag, der zu seinem Freund Egon nach Leipzig will, in deren Abteil. Auf dem Bahnhof angekommen, entführt Blasius die beiden Jungen. Als das merkwürdige Verhalten des wie ein Mensch aussehenden Roboters sie hinter dessen Geheimnis bringt, glauben sie, dass er von Verbrechern für kriminelle Handlungen vorgesehen ist und entführen ihn ihrerseits. Mit ihren Fehlprogrammierungen richten sie große Verwirrung an. Von den Erfindern verfolgt, landen sie auf dem Messegelände, wo ihnen vor großem Publikum eine sensationelle Vorführung von Blasius‘ Fähigkeiten gelingt, so dass dessen Väter doch noch zu ihrem Erfolg kommen.

programme.title: Wir kaufen eine Feuerwehr
programme.desc: Der kleine Matti langweilt sich, weil er niemanden zum Spielen hat. In den Kindergarten kann er auch nicht, da seine Mutter wegen der einjährigen Zwillinge nicht arbeiten kann. Er will schon per Aushang nach neuen Freunden suchen, doch da lernt er Herrn Clasen kennen. Er nimmt Matti mit in seine Werkstatt und zeigt ihm Werkzeuge und Autoteile. Der Junge ist begeistert. Auf einem Schrottplatz entdecken sie ein altes Feuerwehrauto. Da Herr Clasen im Lotto gewonnen hat, kauft er die Feuerwehr und gemeinsam mit den Kindern aus der Nachbarschaft wird diese wieder hergerichtet. So kommt es zur ersten großen Fahrt ..

programme.title: Das Märchenschloss
programme.desc: Drei Brüder ziehen aus, um die Objekte ihrer Träume zu suchen. Die beiden älteren, Klaus und Günter, suchen einen Mähdrescher und einen Traktor. Peter dagegen, der jüngste, träumt von einem Märchenschloss. Während die anderen die Suche längst aufgegeben haben, läuft Peter das Pony Pedro über den Weg und führt ihn zum Rosenschloss, das sich als Kindergarten der benachbarten LPG erweist. Weil Peter den Kindern das entlaufene Pony wiedergebracht hat, nehmen sie ihn und seine Brüder mit zum Erntefest. Und alles ist noch viel schöner, als sie es sich erträumten.

programme.title: Schneewittchen
programme.desc: Schneewittchen flüchtet vor ihrer bösen Stiefmutter zu den sieben Zwergen hinter den sieben Bergen. Dort kümmert sie sich aufopfernd um den Haushalt. Doch die missgünstige Stiefmutter will ihren Tod.

programme.title: Sechse kommen durch die Welt
programme.desc: Im Lande Malabunt entlässt der König nach einem Krieg seine geschlagenen Soldaten mit einem kärglichen Wegegeld. Einer der Betrogenen protestiert und prophezeit dem König, er werde eines Tages noch alle Schätze des Landes herausgeben müssen. In den Kerker gesteckt, trifft der Soldat den ersten Partner für seine Vergeltung: den Starken. Mit einem kräftigen Niesen sprengt dieser die Kerkertüren, und auf der gemeinsamen Wanderschaft treffen sie den schnellsten Läufer, den Musiker, dessen Fiedel jeden tanzen lässt, den Jäger mit treffsicherem Schuss und das Mädchen Schiefhütchen, das Frost machen kann. Gemeinsam ziehen sie zum Hof, wo sie sich dem Wettkampf stellen, ihren verdienten Lohn gegen alle Tücken des Königs verteidigen und am Ende mit all seinen Schätzen abziehen, um sie an das Volk zu verteilen.

programme.title: Der neue Fimmel
programme.desc: Fußballbegeisterte Kinder gründen einen Verein. Mit Hilfe eines Oberligaspielers lernen sie Teamgeist und Verantwortung.

programme.title: Verflixtes Missgeschick
programme.desc: Glück hat nur, wer Leid nicht fürchtet! Carmen-Maja Antoni als Missgeschick in einer Paraderolle. Ein armer Holzfäller wird vom Missgeschick verfolgt. Er kann es nur loswerden, wenn er es an andere weitergibt. So gelangt es zu einem Kaufmann, der von Räubern überfallen wird. Der gibt es an den König weiter, der bald darauf ruiniert ist und gegen die Nachbarstaaten zum Krieg rüsten muss. Erst dem jungen Bauern Michael gelingt es, dieses verflixte Missgeschick loszuwerden.

programme.title: Turlis Abenteuer
programme.desc: Der lebendige Kasper Turli erlebt Abenteuer, besiegt den bösen Muriel und befreit verwandelte Kinder aus seiner Gewalt.

programme.title: Die vertauschte Königin
programme.desc: Auf einem Schloss lebt eine herrschsüchtige, launische Königin, die ihre Untertanen jeden Morgen mit einem Kanonenschuss wecken lässt. Die Kugel fällt regelmäßig in den Brunnen einer Schmiede, zum Ärger des Schmieds. Als der Kanonier den Unmut seiner Königin erweckt und sie ihn zum täglichen Auspeitschen verurteilt, wendet er sich hilfesuchend an den Hofnarren. Der hat einen klugen wie gefährlichen Plan, der Königin eine Lehre zu erteilen. Er vertauscht sie eines Nachts mit der Gemahlin des Schmieds, die nicht nur eine gute Hausfrau, sondern auch klug und gerecht ist und der Königin zum Verwechseln ähnlich sieht. Während der Schmied an seiner vermeintlichen Frau fast verzweifelt und sie ihre Unfähigkeit einsehen muss, nutzt die Schmiedin ihre Position als Königin, um Gutes zu tun, begnadigt auch den Kanonier. Nach 24 Stunden wird der Tausch, der wie ein Traum wirken sollte, rückgängig gemacht. Und die Königin lässt sich, um einige Erfahrungen reicher, nichts anmerken.

programme.title: Die Schauspielerin
programme.desc: In den dreißiger Jahren lernen sich die Schauspieler Maria Rheine und Mark Löwenthal an einem kleinen Theater kennen. Sie verlieben sich ineinander. Dem Juden Mark wird gekündigt, Maria macht Karriere. Auf einer großen Münchner Bühne wird sie als "Jungfrau von Orleans" gefeiert. Am Premierenabend findet sie von Mark, der ans Jüdische Theater nach Berlin gegangen ist, einen Blumenstrauß in ihrer Garderobe. Nach dem Erlaß der "Nürnberger Gesetze" kann er ihr persönlich nicht mehr begegnen, ohne sie zu gefährden. Doch Maria entscheidet sich für ihre Liebe. Sie täuscht einen Selbstmord vor und fährt mit dunkel gefärbten Haaren und einem gefälschten Paß auf den Namen Manja Löwenthal nach Berlin zu Mark. Sie hat eine Rolle angenommen, von der sie weiß, daß sie den Tod bringen kann. Ein Zurück gibt es für sie nicht. Sie läßt sich ebenfalls am Jüdischen Theater engagieren.

programme.title: Treffen in Travers
programme.desc: Im Herbst 1793 trifft sich der in Paris lebende Georg Forster in einem einsamen Gasthof in der Schweiz mit seiner Frau Therese, um die Scheidung zu besprechen. Therese ist mit den beiden gemeinsamen Kindern und ihrem neuen Lebensgefährten Ferdinand Huber gekommen. Der physisch und psychisch von den revolutionären Kämpfen in Frankreich geschwächte Forster versucht, Therese zu überreden, mit ihm nach Paris zu fahren. Er ist bereit, Huber als Dritten im Bunde zu akzeptieren. Therese, die wegen der politischen Tätigkeit ihres Mannes im Schweizer Exil lebt, möchte die Scheidung, um nach Deutschland zurück zu können. Sie versucht, auch Forster zur Rückkehr zu bewegen, damit er endlich zur Ruhe kommt. Sie lehnt es ab, mit ihm nach Paris zu gehen, obwohl sie ihn noch immer liebt. Therese weiß, daß er sein Privatleben stets der Arbeit für die Revolution opfern würde. Und sie weiß, daß Huber sie braucht.

programme.title: An der Unstrut
programme.desc: Memleben im Unstruttal (heute Sachsen-Anhalt) war vor mehr als 1000 Jahren Mittelpunkt Europas, Lieblingspfalz und Sterbeort des ersten deutschen Königs Heinrich I. (um 875-936) und seines Sohns Otto I. (912-973). Die Klosterruine, die Burgruine Wendelstein erinnern an Vergangenes. Der Schauspieler Rolf Hoppe liest Texte von den Schriftstellern Willibald Alexis, Friedrich Hölderlin, Johannes Bobrowski und Wladimir Majakowski. In den 1980er Jahren prägen auch das Zementwerk, die Abraumpyramide des Kalischachts "Heinrich Rau" und das volkseigene Gut mit seinem Getreide- und Weinanbau das Gesicht der Landschaft und die Lebensweise der Menschen. Arbeiter aus dem Kalischacht, ein Schäfer und eine Mitarbeiterin für Umweltschutz im Kulturbund sowie junge und ältere Menschen kommen zu Wort.

programme.title: Letztes Jahr Titanic
programme.desc: Diese Produktion ist die gedankliche Weiterführung der im Oktober 1989 begonnenen und auf dem Leipziger Festival Ende November 1989 uraufgeführten Dokumentation über die politischen Ereignisse im Herbst 1989 in Leipzig. Lebensgeschichten, Schicksale, Alltagsgeschichten in Leipzig - aufgenommen von Dezember 1989 bis Dezember 1990, im letzten Jahr der Deutschen Demokratischen Republik. Wie erleben die Leute in Leipzig dieses Jahr? Wahlkämpfe und Wahlen, die D-Mark, das Reisen, die zunehmende wirtschaftliche Unsicherheit, schließlich das Ende der DDR, die deutsche Einheit. Wolfgang, der Eisengießer war zweimal wegen "versuchter Republikflucht" im Gefängnis. Er wollte so schnell wie möglich die Westmark und die Wiedervereinigung und gleich am Anfang des Jahres in den Westen. Jetzt, ein Jahr später ist er immer noch da und mittlerweile auf Kurzarbeit. Sylvia macht ihre Kneipe zu. Ihr Mann hat schon Arbeit in Bayern. Nach der Währungsunion geht auch sie. Renate, eine eigenwillige Journalistin spricht über ihre Kontakte zur Staatssicherheit, über Verantwortung und Schuld. Isabell ist vierzehn und Schülerin. Am Tag des neuen Geldes kommen ihr die Tränen. Für John den Redskin und Hausbesetzer, sind Faschos keine Menschen und Gewalt gegen sie der einzige Weg.

programme.title: Jubiläum einer Stadt - 750 Jahre Rostock
programme.desc: Dieser Farb-Dokumentarfilm, der auch als Werbefilm für Rostock und Warnemünde gelten kann, verzichtet auf jegliche Kommentierung. Zur einer Suite des Komponisten Günter Kochan werden elf Filmthemen umgesetzt. Wechselseitige Bildsequenzen des Alten und Neuen Rostock fügen sich harmonisch in die Musik ein und zeigen so eine stolze, aber auch geschundene Hansestadt, bis hin zum 750. Jubiläum mit seinen nationalen und internationalen Gästen.

programme.title: Die Schauspielerin
programme.desc: In den dreißiger Jahren lernen sich die Schauspieler Maria Rheine und Mark Löwenthal an einem kleinen Theater kennen. Sie verlieben sich ineinander. programme.title: Alle meine Mädchen
programme.desc: Ralf Päschke, Regiestudent an der Filmhochschule, will einen Film über eine Frauenbrigade im Berliner Glühlampenwerk NARVA drehen. Die fünf Mädchen um die souveräne Meisterin Boltzin, die er kennenlernt, sind ein ausgezeichnetes Arbeitskollektiv, doch er merkt bald, dass es unter der Oberfläche Probleme und Spannungen gibt. Besonders gegenüber Kerstin existieren Vorbehalte. Sie ist Abiturientin, wegen Diebstahls vorbestraft und zur Bewährung in der Brigade. Zu einer heftigen Auseinandersetzung mit der Meisterin kommt es, als die Mädchen entdecken, daß sie über die Disziplinverstöße der Einzelnen Buch führt. Die Meisterin wird mit einem Nervenzusammenbruch ins Krankenhaus eingeliefert. Und Kerstin verlässt die Brigade, als Geld verschwindet und man sie der Tat verdächtigt. Auch von Ralf, der Kerstin sehr mag und der Brigade inzwischen fest verbunden ist, wird sie enttäuscht.

programme.title: Rosa Luxemburg - Stationen ihres Lebens
programme.desc: Ein Film, der unter Verwendung seltener historischer Dokumentaraufnahmen den Lebensweg dieser revolutionären Führerin der deutschen und internationalen Arbeiterbewegung skizziert. Das politische Vermächtnis der unbeugsamen Kämpferin, die im Jahre 1919 von der deutschen Reaktion ermordet wurde, wird in der DDR mit dem Aufbau des Sozialismus erfüllt.

programme.title: DEFA Kinobox 1984/35
programme.desc: Anfang der 1980er Jahre verschwand aus den Kinos der DDR die Wochenschau »Der Augenzeuge« und wurde durch die »DEFA KINOBOX« ersetzt. Wenn Sie wissen wollen, wie Kleiderbügel hergestellt wurden in den 1980er Jahren, ist es hier zu sehen. Sehr aufschlussreich auch der Besuch bei der Instrumentenbaufirma Förster, mit Sitz in Löbau. Bis heute werden dort hochwertige Flügel und Klaviere gebaut und zum klingen gebracht.

programme.title: DEFA Kinobox 1984/36
programme.desc: Früher Rock 'n' Roll - heute Laufsteg! Sie verstand es schon damals, gemeinsam mit den anderen Frauen der Band „Mona Lise“, auf der Bühne eine gute Figur zu machen - Lieselotte Reznicek. Heute, mit 66 Jahren, singt und spielt sie nicht, sondern schreitet über den Laufsteg in der aktuellen Staffel „Germany's Next Topmodel“. Lieselotte hat es schon bis ins Halbfinale geschafft. Vielleicht gelingt es ihr und sie erobert im reifen Alter die Laufstege der großen Welt. In der Kinobox von 1984 erzählt sie über die Entstehung dieser Frauen-Band. Beiträge in dieser DEFA KINOBOX: 00:00:28 Friedensfahrt - Einzelzeitfahren 1984 00:04:45 Uli Schulze - Arbeiter und Neuerer 00:09:04 Mona Lise - Mädchen-Rock-Band 00:14:48 Dimitroff - Kommunistin Irene Harlow berichtet über konspirative Arbeit im Prenzlauer Berg.

programme.title: Die Mauer
programme.desc: Ein eindringlicher Film - zum Teil auch experimentellen Charakters - über die Berliner Mauer, im Zentrum der Stadt am Potsdamer Platz und am Brandenburger Tor. Ein Film über ihre letzten Tage, ihren Abriss, der vom Zuschauer sinnlich miterlebt wird. Ein Film, dessen ausdrucksstarke Bilder und collageartige Tonebenen die assoziativen Kräfte des Betrachters wecken. Ein Film, dessen Gesichter und Szenen gegenwärtigen Geschehens auf eindrucksvolle Weise erweitert werden durch Projektionen historischer Sequenzen auf die Reste dieses inhumanen Bauwerkes.

programme.title: …und ich dachte, du magst mich
programme.desc: Schon im Bus auf der Fahrt ins Ferienlager gefällt der elfjährigen Lena der ein Jahr ältere Wolfgang. Auch die eitle Antonia hat ein Auge auf ihn geworfen, doch Wolfgang erwidert Lenas Lächeln. Eine Freundschaft bahnt sich an. Im Gegensatz zu der jungen Betreuerin Susanne haben Heimleiter Eichler und Lehrerin Busse wenig Verständnis für die Gefühlsregungen der Kinder. Als Lena und Wolfgang sich von den anderen absondern, werden sie in verschiedene Gruppen gesteckt. Lena protestiert beim Heimleiter. Der Konflikt spitzt sich während einer Disco-Veranstaltung zu, und Lena läuft weg. Die Suchaktion bleibt erfolglos. Nur Wolfgang ahnt, wo sie ist. Er bringt sie zurück.

programme.title: Meine Frau macht Musik
programme.desc: Gustl Wagner ist Leiter der Schallplattenabteilung eines großen Berliner Kaufhauses und seit zehn Jahren glücklich mit seiner Frau Gerda verheiratet, mit der er zwei Kinder hat. Für die Ehe legte Gerda ihre Karriereambitionen als Sängerin ad acta und singt nur noch zu Hause. Ein Zufall bringt Gerda in Kontakt mit dem schillernden Sänger Fabiani. Die Lust auf einen großen Bühnenauftritt kehrt zurück. Der eifersüchtige Gustl plant den Auftritt seiner Frau im Varieté zu stören.

programme.title: Biologie
programme.desc: Im letzten Schuljahr an der Oberschule unternimmt die 15-jährige Ulla gemeinsam mit ihrer Klasse und ihrem Lehrer eine Exkursion ins Landschaftsschutzgebiet. Sie entdeckt, dass dort eine Datsche gebaut und eine Forellenzucht betrieben wird. In ihr regt sich Widerstand. Ulla ist nicht bereit, die Eingriffe in die Natur hinzunehmen und setzt für ihre Ideale die eigene Zukunft bedingungslos aufs Spiel. Während sich viele Jugendliche für Natur- und Artenschutz einsetzen, stößt ihr Engagement in der Erwachsenengeneration auf Unverständnis.

programme.title: Die Suche nach dem wunderbunten Vögelchen
programme.desc: Das Kinderheim "Sonnenschein" im kleinen Städtchen Käsebrot besitzt mit dem wunderbunten Vögelchen einen einmaligen Schatz. Dessen Gesang lässt die Blumen erblühen, den Springbrunnen sprudeln und weckt morgens die Kinder. Eines Tages wird es gestohlen. Polizei und Kinder suchen es. Die Spur führt auf den Rummelplatz in Butterberg. In dem bunten Treiben stoßen die Kinder auf mehrere Verdächtige: den Vogelstimmenmann, den Zuckerwattemann und den Zauberer. Lutz macht sich selbstständig und gerät in die Hände des bösen Zauberers. Die Polizei kommt rechtzeitig, um ihn zu befreien und das Vögelchen zu retten.

programme.title: Das Fahrrad
programme.desc: Susanne, ungelernte Arbeiterin, allein mit einem Kind, schlägt sich mehr schlecht als recht durchs Leben. Ihre Unzufriedenheit nimmt zu, als sie den erfolgreichen Ingenieur Thomas kennenlernt. Sie gibt ihre Arbeit auf, gerät in finanzielle Schwierigkeiten und meldet ihr Fahrrad als gestohlen, um die Versicherungssumme zu kassieren. Der Betrug fliegt auf, und sie landet vor dem Staatsanwalt. Sie ist deprimiert, und Thomas, der von dem Betrug nichts weiß, kümmert sich um sie. Als sie ihm die Sache und das bevorstehende Verfahren gesteht, stößt sie auf Unverständnis, und ihre Beziehung erhält einen Knacks. Thomas steht ihr zwar bei, aber seine Reaktion macht sie betroffen. Sie trennt sich von ihm, ist aber entschlossen, ihr Leben zu verändern.

programme.title: Verbotene Liebe
programme.desc: Georg ist 18 Jahre alt und Musterschüler. Sein Wechsel an die Erweiterte Oberschule ist längst vorprogrammiert. Doch nun steht er vor Gericht; angeklagt wegen sexuellen Missbrauchs einer Minderjährigen. Rückblickend wird die Liebesgeschichte zwischen dem 18-jährigen und der 13-jährigen Barbara erzählt: erste Annäherungen, ablehnende Haltung der Eltern, Anfeindungen der Nachbarskinder, Hilflosigkeit der Lehrkräfte. Die gesetzlich verbotene Liebe scheint stärker als alle äußeren Widerstände.

programme.title: Nelken in Aspik
programme.desc: Werbezeichner Wolfgang Schmidt ist ein miserabler Zeichner, dafür aber ein gewandter Redner und hat zahlreiche gesellschaftliche Ämter im Haus der Werbung inne. Plötzlich erscheint Siegfried Huster von der übergeordneten Dienststelle, um einen neuen Mitarbeiter für die Hauptverwaltung auszuwählen. Schmidts Kaderakte macht Eindruck, und dessen als weise eingestuftes plötzliches schweigsames Verhalten auch - er hat gerade zwei Schneidezähne eingebüßt. So macht Schmidt schweigend Karriere und fühlt sich gar nicht wohl, weil er den Aufgaben nicht gewachsen ist. Alles was er unternimmt, um sich selbst zu Fall zu bringen, wird ein Erfolg. Nur bei seiner Kollegin Cilly kommt er mit seinem Schweigen nicht so recht voran. Als er es bis zum Generaldirektor gebracht hat, wird die Fehlbesetzung endlich erkannt. Es kommt zu seinem Fall - ins Glück. Er erobert Cilly und findet - wieder mit Zähnen - als Führer bei Stadtrundfahrten eine seinem Redetalent angemessene Beschäftigung.

programme.title: Das Versteck
programme.desc: Ein Jahr nach seiner Scheidung versucht Max, seine Frau zurückzugewinnen. Er gibt vor, von der Polizei gesucht zu werden und sich bei ihr verstecken zu wollen. Wanda geht darauf ein. Anfangs wehrt sie sich gegen Max’ Versuche, ihre Beziehung wiederzubeleben, lässt sich dann doch beinahe verführen. Dabei kommt sie hinter den Schwindel, lässt sich aber nichts anmerken.

programme.title: Hauptmann Florian von der Mühle
programme.desc: Müller Florian kämpft in Wien mit List und Mut um sein Recht und gewinnt dabei das Herz einer Herzogin.

programme.title: Jugend-Zeit… in der Stadt
programme.desc: Jugendliche diskutieren über Lebensprobleme wie den Bezug der ersten Wohnung, aber auch über die Gestaltung ihrer eigenen Zukunft.

programme.title: Jugend-Zeit zu zweit
programme.desc: Junge Leute erzählen vor der Kamera über ihre Vorstellungen von der Ehe, über Pläne für ihr zukünftiges Leben. Die geäußerten Meinungen werfen Fragen auf, deuten Probleme an, für die dem Zuschauer keine Lösungen angeboten werden. Sie sind Anlass zum Nachdenken.

programme.title: Jugendwerkhof
programme.desc: Der Film erzählt von der 15-jährigen Maiga. Nachdem sie gestohlen und die Schule geschwänzt hat, kommt sie in den Jugendwerkhof. Das Mädchen wird in den ersten vier Wochen im Werkhof begleitet.

programme.title: Berlin - Bauplatz der Jugend
programme.desc: Ein Dokumentarfilm, der die Verpflichtung und Umsetzung der FDJ zum Ausbau des Wohnungsbestandes in der Hauptstadt zeigt. Hervorzuheben ist der starke Einsatzwille der jungen Baubrigaden und die ungebrochene Motivation hieran mitzuwirken zum Wohle der Allgemeinheit. Am Beispiel eines Neubaugebietes in Marzahn und der Renovierung eines alten Wohnhausbestandes im Stadtteil Prenzlauer Berg wird die aufopfernde Arbeit der jungen Menschen gezeigt.

programme.title: Film-Salabim
programme.desc: Auf heiter-phantastische Weise werden Kinder in die Zauberwelt Kino eingeführt. Eingebettet in eine turbulente Geschichte werden die Filmberufe vorgestellt.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: Examining how warfare entered a new dimension as attacks from the skies became possible with weapons from incendiary arrows to drones.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: Experts look at three types of weapon employed to attack civilian populations, from the medieval trebuchet to modern bio-weapons and nuclear bombs.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: Wars become even bloodier as new technologies continue to evolve. An international team of experts tests the deadliest weapons upgrades in the history of warfare.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: The Avro Lancaster is the legendary British heavy bomber that carved its place in history with Bomber Command during World War 2. That conflict saw over seven thousand of these iconic aircraft come off the production line.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.sub-title: The Spitfire: A British Fighter Legend
programme.desc: Unusually, we look at the later, clipped wing version flown by Czech refugee pilots in the UK during WW2. We get close-up with a beautifully restored example, fly her and unearth long unseen test and operational footage.

programme.title: WWII Air Crash Detectives
programme.desc: For the men about to board "Miss Every Morning Fixin.

programme.title: WWII Air Crash Detectives
programme.sub-title: Turweston Wellington Collision: Death in the Moonlight
programme.desc: In the early hours of 8th July 1944, a normally quiet part of rural Northamptonshire was a hive of activity as the 17 twinned engine Wellington bombers rumbled down the runway of their Turweston airfield home.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: Weapons experts test the physical and psychological impact of close combat weapons - the Roman short sword, the medieval war hammer and the bayonet.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: From the crossbow to the Kalashnikov to 3D-printed firearms, weaponry designed for everyone can offer a decisive advantage in warfare.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: Ranged weapons guarantee a warrior's best chance of survival. International experts survey history’s most important ranged weapons, from the Roman spear and the English longbow, right up to the futuristic railgun.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: Examining how warfare entered a new dimension as attacks from the skies became possible with weapons from incendiary arrows to drones.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: The aircraft capable of delivering the payload of a B17, in a single post war air frame. The many variants of this single piston engined fighter bomber helped dominate the air to ground attack role in Vietnam, earning quite a reputation.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: The definitive combat helicopter saw first blood in South East Asia and has been transport, gunship, smoke ship, command centre, MediVac and dozens of other roles. We hear and see it's hair raising missions and watch it earn its fame.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: In spectacular experiments, a team of international experts presents the most significant cases in the history of weapons where speed has made a decisive difference.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: New weapons with devastating force shape the wars of the 20th century. International experts test the catastrophic effects of the three most destructive weapons of our time: the machine gun, hand grenade and tank.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: During WWII, the French Resistance seeks aid from SOE. Led by Vera Atkins, Odette Sansom and Noor Inayat Khan fight the Nazis, risking it all for victory.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: Vera enlists Violette Szabo and Yvonne Baseden. With circuits failing and Noor at risk, treachery allegations harm preparations for the Allied invasion.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: With Allied victories and the liberation of Paris following D-Day, Vera is in a race against time to locate her missing agents.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: Armed with evidence from Odette, Vera intensifies her search at Karlsruhe prison and Ravensbruck, facing hurdles to uncover crucial results in Germany.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: Vera finds out her agents' fate. Her beliefs about Noor are challenged. Suspicions lead Vera to hunt down a Nazi mastermind.

programme.desc: Capture of a key Nazi uncovers shocking realities. Amid demands for accountability, as Vera and her team navigate murky waters to confront uncomfortable truths.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Upon landing on Planet PX3 989, the mysterious alien Harlan renders the SG-1 team unconscious. After waking and returning to Earth, they find that their spirits and minds have been transferred to androids. Can the team regain their bodies and souls?

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: A mysterious mirror transports Dr. Jackson to an alternate Earth that is under attack from the Goa'uld.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Part one of three. Cost-conscious Senator Kinsey vows to shut down the Stargate project, riding roughshod over Daniel's objections and contemptuously dismissing the danger of an imminent attack by the Goa'uld. Richard Dean Anderson stars.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: To stop the Goa'uld invasion, the SG-1 team disobeys orders and transports itself to the Goa'uld attack headquarters. Landing amidst preparations for an all-out strike on Earth, the way home is blocked. Can the team avert disaster and save humanity?

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: As a fleet of Goa'uld warships heads toward Earth, threatening to destroy it, the Stargate facility prepares for the worst, sending the best and brightest of American society through the Stargate to a safe Alpha site.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: On a daring mission to rescue victims of an interplanetary attack, Carter's body is inhabited by a Goa'uld. And now that Carter has brought the demon back to Earth inside her, the SG-1 team must find a way to destroy it....without destroying Carter!

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: While exploring a seemingly insignificant planet, Col. Jack O'Neill and the SG-1 team are approached by a ragged figure who pleads for their help from a pursuer named Taldor.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: While investigating an unknown planet, the SG-1 team discovers enigmatic structures that appear to contain various unconscious people; after being captured, the team is forced to relive painful memories from their pasts.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Daniel finds himself becoming increasingly involved in a romance with the stunningly attractive Princess of an alien civilization, and he finds that his newfound situation has granted him the chance to save the SG-1 from a harrowing fate.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The SG-1 team must help stop a Goa'uld invasion on a planet whose main defence was Thor's hammer - which was destroyed by the team during an earlier visit.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: While exploring a now-dead planet, Col. Jack O'Neill and the SG-1 team find an orb that sends out electromagnetic signals. They think it is a time capsule of some sort and are intrigued by its power source, which seems to have lasted a millennium.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 goes on a mission to rescue Teal'c's son, Rya'c, from the grasp of Apophis. But, when they finally reach Rya'c, he doesn't want to be saved -- he's been brainwashed and has accepted Apophis as his god! Can Teal'c find a way to win back his son?

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Daniel Jackson learns that his wife is pregnant with Apophis' child and O'Neill discovers that a reporter is ready to blow the lid off the top-secret Stargate project.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: O'Neill and the team are attacked by giant insects while exploring a new planet and try to retreat through the Stargate, but Teal'c is stung before they can escape. Once back at the SGC, he begins to undergo a terrifying transformation. Sci-fi drama, starring Christopher Judge and Richard Dean Anderson.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Using coordinates that Carter found in a dream, SG-1 contacts the Tok'ra with the hope of creating an alliance against the Goa'uld System Lords; Dr. Carter is informed of her father's debilitating health due to lymphoma.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The Tok'ra are desperate for hosts so they can continue fighting the Goa'uld. Carter's father, who is dying of cancer, has nothing to lose by volunteering his body. But will he die during the transference...or does fate have something else in store?

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The SG-11 team has not returned from its mission to planet PXY-887, where they recently discovered an element, Trinium, that is a hundred times lighter and stronger than steel. Instead, the inhabitants of the planet have fired an arrow made of Trinium through the Stargate and into the shoulder of Jack O'Neill.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 travels to the planet Madrona in order to study a weather manipulation device, but the Madronans accuse O'Neill's team of theft after they witness the device being taken by men dressed in the uniforms of Stargate Command.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: While trying to save fellow Stargate officers from a black hole, the SG-1 team and Earth becomes threatened by the hole's potentially fatal gravitational pull.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: A black hole swallows the SG-10 team, and O'Neill is sent on a rescue mission.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 discovers an elderly man known for developing technology to fight the Goa'uld. Daniel is tricked into switching bodies with the man.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1's arch-enemy Apophis is dying and seeks sanctuary with O'Neill. But what he really wants is a new host in exchange for his knowledge of the Goa'uld. Will O'Neill grant his request or send him back to the Goa'uld to face his fate?

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: On a routine recon mission, the SG-1 team discovers a new, friendly life form. But the encounter turns deadly for the new race because of a virus SG-1 inadvertently introduces. Can SG-1 develop a vaccine before this plague eradicates a civilization?

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The team at SGC learns shocking news from a young member of the Reetou race when he enters through the gate and announces that a group of rebels, in response to an attack from the Goa'uld, are on a mission to destroy all of humankind.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When a solar flare sends the SG-1 team back in time to the year 1969, they end up in the custody of the military police stationed at Cheyenne Mountain and must devise a way of escaping that won't alter the course of time.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When Colonel Jack O'Neill awakens in what appears to be the future, a group of scientists inform him that he has been frozen for the past 80 years before moving on to question him about the strengths and weaknesses of the Goa'uld.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: O'Neill, Carter and Jackson must escape Hathor's clutches, while Teal'c tries to raise a Jaffa army on Chulak.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: A Goa'uld lord is discovered living on Earth in the form of a religious leader with an armed cult following.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The Goa'uld lords will halt an attack on Earth, but only if the Stargate is destroyed.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: A mysterious tablet discovered on a distant planet infects anyone who touches it with a hallucinogen.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 discovers a planet where children are used to acquire knowledge for the entire population, then discarded.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Stargate Command is taken aback when an alternate-reality version of Samantha Carter and the deceased Maj. Kawalsky are found in a secured building in top-secret Area 51.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 travels to planet PJ6-877 for a routine recon. Almost immediately after arriving, they are snared in an invisible forcefield by alien bounty hunter Aris Boch. Aris takes them to his cargo ship, which is completely invisible from the outside. He has come to this planet to hunt a Goa'uld named Kel'tar, who is wanted by the evil system lord Sokar.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 finds a medieval Christian society terrorized by Sokar and the Unas, and is accused of being possessed by demons.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Upon exiting the stargate, SG-1 finds itself in the midst of battle. A group of SG soldiers battles a Jaffa army. Believing the soldiers to be the missing-in-action SG-11 team, Col. Jack O'Neill and the others provide assistance. Much to their surprise, the mystery SG team turns their weapons against SG-1! SG-1 wakes up in the soldiers' training camp with headaches and no weapons.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: During a rescue of captured Abydonians, Daniel finds his missing wife, Sha're. But instead of greeting him, she attacks him - leading to her death at the hands of Teal'c. Distraught over her death and angry at Teal'c, Daniel quits Stargate Command.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 encounters an entire planet suffering from amnesia. The planet's leader returns to Earth with SG-1 to find a cure.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Carter's father has been captured on a moon transformed into hell. Only Jolinar's memories can save him.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: During a rescue attempt, SG-1 is caught by one of hell's denizens, who is determined to use the information they have to overthrow Goa'uld lord Sokar. Using Tok'ra technology, the team is forced to relive painful memories... but how much can they take?

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: En route to the infirmary after an extended mission, SG-1 learns that part of Stargate Command has been sealed off because of a chemical leak.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The Tollan Narim invites SG-1 to participate in a ritual known as Triad. Only when SG-1 shows up do they learn that Triad is a ceremony of justice.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: En route to a planet, the SG-1 are implanted with an alien spore that evolves into a being called Urgo. Though Urgo claims to be friendly, the suspicious team members work feverishly to rid themselves of the creature before it destroys their minds.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: After a meteor strike buries the Stargate, O'Neill finds himself stranded on a planet with no hope of rescue.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 travels to Tollana to negotiate a trade. Col. Jack O'Neill becomes extremely annoyed when the Tollans refuse to cooperate, due to their fear that any weaponry given to Earth would more likely be used on itself than to protect against the Goa'uld.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 journeys to a planet where their arrival ignites a war between two cultures. A spy realizes his side could win the war if SG-1 and the Stargate can be neutralized. Will O'Neill and his team make the same realization and save themselves in time?

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Bra'tac accompanied by his battered Jaffa apprentice arrives at Stargate Command pleading for medical assistance. He announces that Chulak the home planet to himself and Teal'c has been brutally attacked by Apophis and he goes on to explain that it was as though Apophis was looking for something. Dr. Daniel Jackson deduces that the something had to be Harsesis the child Apophis fathered with Sha're/Amaunet. This forbidden child would contain all the knowledge of the Goa'uld and if he were to fall into the wrong hands could be the Goa'uld's undoing.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: An alien artifact causes Daniel to disappear, and the team looks for help from his institutionalized grandfather.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: While preparing for a week of leave, Col. Jack O'Neill is engulfed in a white glow and disappears. Maj. Samantha Carter immediately recognizes that O'Neill has been transported away by the Asgard.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 is called upon to help a race of gentle, highly-intelligent aliens struggling against a swarm of deadly mechanical spiders called \.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Stargate Command is contacted by Alar, a representative of the planet Euronda. His people are under attack and in need of help. Gen. Hammond sends SG-1 on a humanitarian mission to deliver food and medical supplies.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Anise, a new Tok'ra representative to Earth, approaches Stargate Command for help in testing some mysterious armband devices discovered amid the ruins of a distant planet. Anise believes the devices could be a powerful weapon in their war against the Goa'uld.Because symbiotes seem to render the devices ineffective, she requires human test subjects to prove her theory.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: An incoming traveller, identified as a Jaffa priestess with whom Teal'C once had a relationship, claims to know how to destroy the Goa'uld.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: A meeting of the Tok'ra High Council goes haywire when an SGC soldier flips out, attacking the council members before taking his own life, putting fear in the SGC as they realize that the Goa'uld now have a mind control weapon.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The SG-1 team meets Malikai, a human explorer from another world who shares Jackson's interest in an alien computer covered in a Latin-like script.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When the stargate won't open, trapping teams offworld, the SG-1 team investigates and learns that the Russians have their own stargate, apparently recovered from the sea after an Asgard ship crashed on Earth.The Russian stargate is locked open, maintaining a perpetual wormhole that defies explanation. At the request of Russian scientist Dr.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: While conducting an archeological dig on planet P3X-888, Dr. Daniel Jackson makes a remarkable discovery: a primordial Goa'uld symbiote, an ancient, predatory version of SG-1's parasitical enemies.Before he can bring back his sample however, his team is attacked by an Unas. One team member is killed, and Daniel is dragged off into the wilderness by the giant primitive creature.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: After O'Neill and the team help relocate displaced aliens to a new homeworld, another civilisation tries to colonise the same planet, leaving the team striving to discover a fair solution to the dilemma. Sci-fi drama, starring Richard Dean Anderson and Amanda Tapping.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The members of SG-1 find themselves working in an alien power station with new identities and no memory of their former selves; as the only person who recalls their true identities, it is up to Teal'c to attempt to set things right.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Hammond orders O'Neill and the team to investigate a conspiracy theorist in Montana who claims he is an alien and in possession of a spaceship. While SG-1 is initially sceptical it begins to appear that there is some truth to his story. Sci-fi drama, starring Richard Dean Anderson and Amanda Tapping.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When a recall device is activated on a Goa'uld Death Glider that Teal'c and O'Neill are testing, the two men find themselves trapped on a several-hundred-year journey back to Chulak with only several days worth of oxygen.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When Daniel Jackson returns to Chicago to attend the funeral of his mentor, a celebrated archaeologist, he soon realizes that the death is mysteriously connected to the recent discovery of a 10,000-year-old Egyptian artifact that might be cursed.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The team undertakes a mission to disrupt an alliance between the influential System Lords Apophis and Heru'ur, while Teal'c travels to Chulak to recruit support from the Jaffa warriors in the fight against the Goa'uld. Sci-fi drama, starring Richard Dean Anderson and Christopher Judge.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: General Hammond makes the shock announcement he is stepping down from his post, prompting O'Neill to investigate whether he has a hidden motive. Meanwhile, Hammond's replacement assigns Carter the task of building a planet-destroying bomb.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Ten years into the future, the former members of SG-1 must send a message into the past to prevent the extinction of the human race.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Jackson's teammates notice a disturbing change in him when he is reunited with the Harcesis child and given the Goa'uld genetic memory.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 travels to a planet to investigate a machine that induces narcotic pleasure. But when they try to leave the planet, they are overcome with debilitating withdrawal symptoms, forcing them to stay. Can they free themselves from this addiction?

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: During a visit to the Air Force Academy, Maj. Samantha Carter makes the acquaintance of Jennifer Hailey, a promising young cadet with a rebellious streak. Carter sees great potential in her, but Jennifer seems determined to sabotage her future with the Air Force. She is fiercely independent, opinionated and resentful of Carter, to whom she is constantly being compared.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When SG-1 sends a probe through the Stargate, a powerful electronic impulse comes back through and hides inside SGC's computer. But when the entity suddenly jumps inside Carter's mind, SG-1 must choose between saving SGC and saving Carter's life!

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 encounters a tricky situation when they join forces with androids designed to look like them in a battle against an evil Goa'uld System Lord. Can they fight alongside robotic doppelgangers, or will confusion and contradiction blur the line?

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 pays a visit to the Tok'ra homeworld. They arrive at Vorash on Cronos' mothership -- one of the spoils they claimed following the their recent battle with him.At a meeting with Vorash's High Council, it is revealed that SG-1 intends to lend the Tok'ra the enormous ship in order to help facilitate the Tok'ra's move to a new planet. Tanith is beside himself.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 finds themselves stranded in a crippled ship in a distant galaxy -- with Apophis threatening to destroy them.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: In order to restore Teal'c's memory, Bra'tac confiscates his friend's symbiote and performs a ritual that will bring him to the brink of death; Teal'c experiences flashbacks of his life serving under the System Lord Apophis.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: While investigating an alien device Major Carter (Amanda Tapping) is found unconscious. Resting from suspected exhaustion, she is visited by an invisible being who holds vital secrets to the device and more. But how does she convince SG-1 that she is not delusional? Richard Dean Anderson, Michael Shanks, Christopher Judge and Don S. Davis also star.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: While trying to escape a hostile planet through the Stargate, a fifth member of SG-1 is injured and O'Neill stays behind to help him; SGC refuses to allow the team back through since there is no fifth person on their team.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 discover that their wormhole may accidentally cause the extinction of life on a friendly world.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: On the eve of her birthday, Cassandra (guest star Colleen Rennison) is showing signs of \.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 attempts to rescue Daniel's Unas friend Chaka, who has been enslaved along with the rest of his people; when Colonel O'Neill and Major Carter are captured and imprisoned, Daniel and Teal'c must find a way to rescue them.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: On a rescue mission to recover Russian soldiers believed missing in action on a previously undisclosed trip, the SG-1 team gets trapped in a Goa'uld tomb with a number of decomposed bodies…and a deadly alien monster with an appetite for human flesh! Richard Dean Anderson, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge and Don S. Davis star.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 travels to the planet of Tollana to attend the funeral of their old acquaintance, Chancellor Omoc ('Enigma'). But more surprising than Omoc's sudden death is news that Chancellor Travell has reversed the Tollan government's longstanding policy against sharing their technology. The Tollans are now willing to trade advanced weaponry with Earth and want O'Neill to be the negotiator. But before SG-1 leaves the planet, Carter is secretly passed a small object by her Tollan friend, Narmin. Upon arriving back at the SGC, Carter reveals Narim's object which suddenly projects a holographic image of Narim warning them that Earth is in great danger. General Hammond authorizes the team to return to Tollana and find out more of the motivation for Chancellor Travell's sudden change of policy, and see if there's a hidden agenda behind the deal.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 returns from an off-world mission proudly announcing to General Hammond that through an intermediate race, they have met a highly advanced alien race that's willing to form an alliance with Earth. In particular, they're willing to share their life-extending medical technology with us. When asked who this race is, Carter replies that it is the Aschen, a race that a future version of SG-1 had previously warned us about (episode - 2010). At first unaware of the connection between this alien race and SG-1's warning from the future, Hammond orders Carter to team with Joe, a government envoy (whom she had married in '2010') and move ahead with negotiations. O'Neill, however, is somewhat suspicious, especially so when Hammond makes the connection SG-1's warning from the future. SG-1 returns to the planet to meet with the Aschen and find out the real truth about their new friends.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Major Carter is kidnapped in order to be experimented on by a wealthy businessman who is in the final stages of a terminal illness and needs to be inhabited by a symbiote to live; O'Neill suspects that Maybourne and the NID are involved.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: To monitor the alien Martin, O'Neill becomes tech advisor to a new TV series whose story line is oddly familiar.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: At a secret training facility, a young group of cadets are put through their paces by a tough taskmaster: Colonel Jack O'Neill. Through several rigorous training scenarios we see how hard it is for these four young troops including Lt. Hailey (from last season's \.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: During a near-fatal pursuit by the Goa'uld gliders, Teal'c fails to make it through the Stargate before it is destroyed. Now SG-1 has only 48 hours to reestablish Teal'c's energy signature from the temporary memory of the Stargate before it's erased…for good! Richard Dean Anderson, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge and Don S. Davis star.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: A truce has been declared among the Goa'uld, so that the warlords can attend a summit on the future of universe domination. Since Jackson speaks fluent Goa'uld, he is sent to the summit disguised as an aide. But his real mission is to poison the delegates! Richard Dean Anderson, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge and Don S. Davis star.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Enslaved by the Goa'uld, Dr Jackson attempts to destroy the System Lords, and SG-1 faces an attack on the Tok'ra homeworld.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: As an asteroid hurtles toward Earth, SG-1 uses an abandoned Goa'uld ship as a launch pad for a mega-bomb designed to destroy the rock before impact. But when SGC loses the ship's signal, it's feared that the team is dead and that Earth is in peril.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The Goa'uld K'tano (guest star Rick Worthy), former First Prime of the late Imhotep, is now the leader of a powerful Jaffa rebellion. SG-1 visits K'tano's stronghold with the aim of securing an alliance. But O'Neill and the team soon learn that this strategic partnership may well come at a heavy price. Richard Dean Anderson, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge and Don S. Davis star.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: A dormant android is discovered on a barren planet and transported back to Earth for study. At the SGC, it is placed in a secure environment and activated. The android, a female robot named Reese, demonstrates a childlike curiosity for her environment world and an instant affection for Daniel. As SG-1 questions her in an attempt to find out what happened to her world, the team discovers this seemingly innocent being may hold a menacing secret.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Col. O'Neill must enlist the aid of a couple of convicted felons in a bid to save a planet from the Goa'uld. With an attack looming and the planet's automated defense systems seemingly offline, an entire world's salvation rests in the hands of SG-1 and two former NID operatives. Richard Dean Anderson, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge and Don S. Davis star.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Exposed to a lethal dose of radiation, Dr. Daniel Jackson has just hours to live. SG-1 tries everything in its power to save him, but as the hours tick away, Jackson's spirit meets with each member individually to discuss his next mission: life after death. Richard Dean Anderson, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge and Don S. Davis star.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 mounts a rescue mission to save Heimdall, an Asgard scientist, and secure an underground laboratory before they fall into the hands of Anubis.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Jonas is eager to finish what Dr. Jackson started. The Stargate malfunctions, and Carter informs O'Neill that it could destroy all life on Earth.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: With the Stargate transformed into a timebomb, Earth's only hope lies in a gambit by SG-1 that could result in the loss of the portal forever.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Trapped on a Goa'uld mothership at the bottom of the ocean by Anubis, the SG1 team discover the craft is on self-destruct and that they only have 17 minutes to get out.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When O'Neill contracts a virus from a mysterious female found frozen in the ice, it becomes clear that his only hope of survival is to accept a symbiote from the To'kra.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 investigates a sleepy town on the Oregon coast whose inhabitants harbor a dark secret - the zombie-like townspeople turn out to be their worst nightmare.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Michael Shanks returns for a gripping episode which sees Colonel O'Neill tortured to death and repeatedly revived by an evil System Lord.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Jonas' people ask Earth for military aide in an impending war with their rival nations, but his former mentor offers another solution.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When SG-1 is captured by the Goa'uld, their very survival rests with two unlikely heroes. Enterprise's John Billingsley guest stars.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Tensions rise between the Tok'ra and rebel Jaffa at the S.G.C.'s offworld base when they are attacked by an invisible enemy.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: An alien world offers Earth a medicine with the power to cure any illness -- but the hidden price may be too high to pay.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Rogue NSA officers hijack the X-303 spaceship and demand that Adrian Conrad be brought to the ship. Using his Goa'uld knowledge, Conrad activates the X-303 and takes the ship light-years from Earth as O'Neill and Teal'c stage a daring rescue.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When SG-1 is marooned in deep space, Thor comes to the rescue. He then seek O'Neill's help to combat the Replicators. Convinced they will attack earth if not stopped, O'Neill stages a daring mission to stop the Replicators once and for all.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 returns from an archeological site on another planet carrying an ancient artifact that glows and emits strange energy waves.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When Sen. Kinsey is assassinated in broad daylight in front of a dozen civilian witnesses, Col. Jack O'Neill is the prime suspect, having been seen and videotaped leaving the scene with a rifle in hand.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Maybourne offers to reveal the location of an alien weapons stockpile on the condition that he is allowed to go along. However, his duplicitous plan backfires when he is transported to a deserted moon with O'Neill. Sci-fi drama, starring Tom McBeath and Richard Dean Anderson.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 attempts to save a planet's inhabitants from Nirrti's genetic experimentation, but find themselves to be her next victims.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: With Anubis, the most powerful of the Goa'uld system lords, increasing his ability to acquire and use advanced weaponry against Earth, Gen. Hammond decides to break the secrecy of the Stargate program.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 discovers three human survivors on an off-world planet who claim to be under attack by hostile aliens. While Carter helps repair the ship's computer, she learns that the survivors are hiding a secret…and things may not be all they seem.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Teal'c has a near-death experience, which leads to him having a strange dream in which he and the SG-1 team are human firemen living on Earth and he is preparing to donate a kidney; Daniel tries to help Teal'c distinguish dreams from reality.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 accompanies the X-53 on its voyage into deep space. When the ship drops out of hyperspace, SG-1 is stranded with no means of getting back to Earth. Their only option lies in exploring a nearby planet where a Stargate is thought to be located.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 encounters a civilization desperate to be freed from the clutches of a Goa'uld. While on the planet, Jonas falls ill. His illness is diagnosed as a brain tumor but it gives him the ability to see the future...where SG-1 are walking into a trap!

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 is called to defend the people of Abydos from the Goa'uld once again when they learn that Anubis is about to attack.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: As SG-1 begins its search for the Lost City, they discover that Jackson has been returned by the Ancients without any memory of who he was. While SG-1 tries to help him regain his memory, they discover that the Lost City is not on the same planet.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: As Anubis prepares to attack Kelowna and steal the Naquadria, Teal'c asks Ba'al to lead a revolt against the rogue System Lord.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When a teenage boy claiming to be Colonel O'Neill turns up at the SGC, the team begin an investigation into what happened and why. Unfortunately, time is not on young Jack's side.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: After an injury, Teal'c must put aside his self-doubt when SG-1 launches a mission to rescue his son and his mentor from a Jaffa death camp.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The team gates to a climate-controlled environment amidst a toxic wasteland, whose people are all linked to a central computer.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: While investigating a crashed ship, SG-1 finds hundreds of inhabited pods. While counting, they are all knocked unconscious. Upon returning to SGC, Daniel insists on getting back to the ship and appears to not know where he is nor who anyone else is.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Daniel reunites with former comrade Chaka in a bid to reach a peaceful compromise as SG-3 prepares to do battle with the Unas over a Naquadah mine. Sci-fi drama, starring Richard Dean Anderson and Michael Shanks.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The race begins. After Warrick and co-pilot Carter evade the obstacle course's attack drones they move on to Stage Two in which the racers head into the coronasphere of Hebridan's sun. Then an explosion occurs: The ship's power diverter has been sabotaged and overloaded. The Seberus is heading into the sun. Their only hope is to relocate the Naquadah generator bypass the diverter and supply power directly to the engines.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: An SGC scientist creates a computer virus that can be utilized to shut down enemy Stargates, but he accidentally crashes the entire gate network; a System Lord attempts a power play while all of the Stargates are disabled.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 encounters a race of women warriors whose survival depends on symbiotes harvested from Jaffa. Teal'c and SG-1 must convince the warriors' high priestess to put aside her fear of reliance on a life-saving drug before the Goa'uld destroy them.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 encounters a very advanced bio-engineered warrior endowed with super strength, created by Anubis. While the team sets out to locate the origin of this new foe, Daniel travels to South America in search of a device left on Earth by the Ancients.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Having found the location of the warrior base, Carter is assigned a recon mission to determine Anubis's plans. Meanwhile, O'Neill mounts a mission to South America to rescue Daniel who has been kidnapped by Honduran rebels demanding a ransom.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: While on a routine journey, the Prometheus is attacked by an alien ship and is forced to enter a mysterious interstellar cloud; Dr. Carter awakens to find herself alone on the Prometheus and begins to suffer from hallucinations.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Jonas Quinn returns with news that Naquadria mines of Kelowna will cause an explosion in the planet's core.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Daniel experiences strange dreams centered around his possible knowledge of the Lost City of the Ancients. Suspicious that Daniel's mind is being manipulated, the team must find a way to help him while keeping the secret from the Goa'uld.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When the Beta Site is attacked by Anubis's drones, Carter and Jacob get their first chance to test a new weapon. Jacob is injured and Carter goes MIA.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 SG-3 and SG-5 gate to the address where they find the nomadic tribe and Daniel Jackson. But Daniel doesn't remember O'Neill Carter or Teal'c and he's not sure he wants to remember who he is because he feels he might have done something wrong. Carter convinces Daniel that he was a very good person and to return to SG-1. The team theorizes that Daniel was expelled from the race of Ascended beings by his benefactor Oma after he interfered in human affairs on Abydos.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When the Air Force sends a documentary crew to capture the historical importance of the Stargate program, the members of the SGC are resistant. Tensions rise when an emergency forces General Hammond to restrict the access they're given to the SGC.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Agent Barrett of the NID calls SG-1 to Los Angeles to consult on a mass murder of a rogue sleeper cell by a woman. There they find many Goa'uld artifacts relating to Sekhmet, a subordinate of Ra. How this operation relates to the Goa'uld eludes SG-1.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: On his first day in office, the newly elected president of the United States is told about the Stargate program and must be brought up to speed on the past seven years of its existence. Starring Richard Dean Anderson as Colonel Jack O'Neill, Amanda Tapping as Major Samantha Carter, Christopher Judge as Teal'c, Michael Shanks as Dr. Daniel Jackson, and Don S. Davis as Major General George Hammond.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: O'Neill allows the knowledge of the Ancients to be downloaded into his mind again, even though the first time almost killed him. While he slowly deteriorates, he and SG-1 must race against time to uncover the secret of the Lost City of the Ancients.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When Anubis attacks Earth, General Hammond launches an offensive. Meanwhile, the search for the lost city continues and Jack's health deteriorates.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Carter and Teal'c are in search of the Asgard, trying to save Colonel O'Neill, but they're about to make a horrifying discovery: the Asgard's most deadly enemy has returned with a vengeance. Meanwhile, the System Lords seek an alliance with Earth against a common enemy.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: While the Goa'uld threaten to attack Earth, SG-1 and the Asgard make a last, desperate stand against the Replicators, who have caught Major Carter.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: When Jackson contracts a mysterious illness, O'Neill is convinced that a contagion has infected the base and orders a lockdown. But when Jackson reveals that he was actually possessed by Anubis, O'Neill must discover the identity of the new host!

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: General O'Neill tries to settle into his new job, but faces never-ending crises - including the capture of SG-1 by the Goa'uld.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Daniel is stranded on another planet after the team's arrival on an alien world sparks a\nviolent civil war.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Teal'c is trapped in a virtual reality simulation in which he must defend the base from a Goa'uld super-soldier incursion. To help him, O'Neill joins the 'game'.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Teal'c, having finally been cleared to live off-base, settles into his new neighborhood.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: A businessman threatens to expose the secrets of alien life to the world, forcing Stargate Command to bring him into the loop.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Teal'c and Bra'tac try to convince the warrior-woman rebel leader Ishta to postpone her attack on the Goa'uld.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The members of the SG-1 are shocked to discover that the Stargate has been stolen from the command center by a mysterious beam, and it is soon discovered that The Trust is plotting to poison their enemies with the use of an advanced ship.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: A duplicate of Colonel Carter seeks help from Stargate Command in defeating the Replicator Fifth.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: General Hammond and Daniel go on an expedition on the Prometheus to Atlantis. They encounter an abandoned Goa'uld Al'kesh and decide to salvage it. A Kull warrior rings aboard the ship and rings everyone else onto the Al'kesh leaving only Daniel onboard the Prometheus. The Kull warrior turns out to be a woman named Vala who wants to use Prometheus to evacuate her people from a Goa'uld occupied world. But is she telling the truth?

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 arrives at Harry Maybourne's planet to find that he has been appointed king of a primitive people.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Relations are strained between the US government and Russia, Colonel Chekov pays a visit to General O'Neill with bad news, and security has been compromised.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Jack is shocked when a person he can't remember having ever met invades his home and makes outrageous claims about having his life ruined by his target, in addition to the alarming revelation that he knows all of the Stargate secrets.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Teal'c and Bra'tac believe the time is right to lead their people in an uprising against the Goa'uld. Their plan suffers a setback when an army of Replicators begins to systematically take control of Goa'uld ships and Jackson is taken prisoner.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The Jaffa Resistance assembles an army to retake a holy city. Plus, Baal seeks help from Earth when he is faced with a threat common to both parties.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: After apparently dying, Daniel is surprised to find himself trapped inside the confines of a mysterious diner that is filled with fellow Ascendants; Anubis takes advantage of an opportunity to scheme on complete conquests of the galaxy.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 and O'Neill utilise the time-puddle jumper to go to Ancient Egypt to recover a ZPM. When they return they discover that the future has been altered and SG-1 never existed. Meanwhile, archaeologists find the video camera Daniel took with them to Ancient Egypt with instructions to find the Stargate, track down Teal'c, and return to the past in order to correct the future.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The alternate SG-1 go to Chulak to find Teal'c and Daniel is killed. The alternate Carter, O'Neill, and Teal'c then go back to ancient Egypt to correct the past. They meet the original timeline Daniel who is the only survivor of a failed rebellion against Ra. Together, they must formulate a plan to steal the Stargate so that Ra can not take it with him.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Lieutenant Colonel Cameron Mitchell, the newest member of the SG-1 team, sets out on a mission with Daniel Jackson, Teal'c and Vala to uncover a stash of hidden ancient riches. Ben Browder, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, and Christopher Judge star.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Still bound together by the Jaffa bracelets, Daniel Jackson and Vala are transported to a galaxy populated by worshippers of a strange authority.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Daniel and Vala discover that the reactivation of an ancient communications device has inadvertently resulted in Earth being exposed to a group of deities who are completely unforgiving toward those unwilling to change their beliefs.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: After an hour's separation from Daniel, Vala returns to SGC. Although the bracelets have been removed, their effects have not diminished. To break the link, Mitchell, Jackson, and Teal'c must deal with many people that Vala has used over the years.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 visits a world whose people once worshipped Vala as a god -- and demand that she stand trial when she confesses to manipulating them.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: A Ori Prior has established an ever-growing force-field on a Jaffa-controlled planet. A minor Goa'uld, but also the one who engineered the multiple gate connections required for the defeat of the Replicators, comes to the SGC to offer his help.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: SG-1 investigates when evidence suggests that there are still Goa'uld hiding on Earth -- including a former System Lord.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The crew has an unexpected run-in with the legendary Jaffa of the Sodan, and a heated battle ensues. Mitchell is left wounded, but before he can recover he is abducted by different enemies who train him for a savage fight to the death.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The team stumbles upon a Goa'uld-human hybrid that has been abandoned in a laboratory and takes it to Earth, where extensive studies are carried out on the life form. The results of the experiments reveal it was created from Anubis's DNA.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: After an SGC officer returns to Earth after unknowingly being infected with the Ancient Plague, the virus quickly spreads throughout the United States. Not wanting the Ori to gain control of the Milky Way Galaxy, Orlin yet again descends to help Carter find a cure.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: With the Prior plague threatening all life on Earth, the team enacts a plan to apprehend the Prior who is the cause of the epidemic; the leader of the Jaffa is transformed into a Prior; Teal'c attempts to keep the Jaffa from following the Ori.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: The team travels to a planet where aliens have learned to graft memories from one person to another. However, the mission to initiate trade talks is put in jeopardy when Colonel Mitchell is accused of murder and he vividly remembers committing the crime, leading the rest of SG1 to set out to clear his name. Starring Ben Browder.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: A black hole causes the merging of alternative realities and leads to confusion at Stargate Command as multiple versions of the SG1 team return to the base. The event is bittersweet as the arrivals include some fallen allies whose faces they never thought they would see again. Starring Amanda Tapping and Christopher Judge.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Baal rises up against the Jaffa High Council's democratic ideology, and brainwashes some of the governing body's magnates in a bid to overthrow the regime. Mitchell finds out an old friend is dying, leaving him facing an important decision. Guest starring Cliff Simon.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Daniel is imprisoned on a world under the influence of the Ori, and the Prometheus is caught in a firefight when SG-1 tries to rescue him.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Off The Grid: SG-1 is captured on an alien world after a deal goes wrong. Plus, the planet's Stargate goes missing. Intergalactic action.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: A crop of genetically engineered insects turns deadly, forcing the SG-1 team to destroy them before they and the visiting international diplomats becoming their next victims. Ben Browder, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, and Christopher Judge star.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Mitchell, Carter and Daniel become \.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Vala returns to Stargate Command to deliver startling news. The Ori have been steadily building their arsenal, and plan a crusade against their enemies very soon...

programme.title: Undercover Asia: Black Markets and Slave Trades
programme.desc: On 14 January 2016, Jakarta was hit by the region's first ISIS attack. The men responsible were radicalized by Aman Abdurrahman while in prison. In an exclusive interview, we hear from Aman from behind bars.

programme.desc: Degree Mill exposes an epic fraud scandal. At its centre is Shoaib Ahmed Shaikh, alleged mastermind behind bogus degree sales. Thousands paid millions for worthless paper; some used fake degrees to land real jobs.

programme.desc: On 9/11, a man survives impossible odds in the collapse of the World Trade Center; a Texas man is cut in two by a freak rail accident; a safari guide in Zimbabwe is savagely attacked by a hippo but lives.

During this time, it was also supposedly the site of a brutal axe murder, and through the years, employees have consistently reported activity that they cannot explain.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS visits the abandoned (and skeevy) remains of an art-deco masterpiece, Buffalo Central Terminal. The terminal, a 14-story combination office tower/train station, opened in 1929 and closed 50 years later. After falling through the hands of various owners, the Central Terminal Restoration Corp. acquired it in 1997. In the years since the Terminal's abandonment, it has become a potent source of paranormal stories.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is in Florida to investigate an inn that is a hotbed of paranormal activity. They were both built in the late 1800s, and are believed to house more than just customers.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS investigates a landmark pool hall in team member Steve Gonsalves' hometown. Over the years, the first floor fronted several retail clients, but is now a tavern called Theodore's. Though two separate establishments, Theodore's and Smith's have a common problem; they both experience intense paranormal activity. Now, their owners are working together and asking TAPS to diagnose their decades-old problem.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS returns to investigate another legendary haunted naval landmark--the aircraft carrier USS Hornet in Alameda, CA. The Hornet, the eighth vessel to carry her name, was commissioned at the height of World War II in 1943. She quickly became one of the most highly decorated ships in the Navy and the USS Hornet is considered the most haunted ship in the Navy, past or present.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
